application:business-rule:removed-member.decision: Keep the removed member's expenses in the budget (totals unchanged), mark them as from a former member, revoke all of the removed member's access to the budget and its expenses on every read, and show the owner a confirmation explaining this before removal. A per-removal choice can be added later if the user wants it.

database:business-rule:money-and-currenc.decision: Integer minor units (bigint) plus ISO 4217 currency on every expense and budget; an expense in a budget must be in the budget's currency; when a scanned receipt is in another currency the review screen flags it and asks for the amount in the budget's currency; conversion (M02) stays deferred.

application:authorization:invitation-rul.decision: Owner-only invites; single-use random token stored hashed; 7-day expiry; accepted only by a signed-in account whose verified email matches the invitation.

application:business-rule:category-on-sc.decision: Category is a required choice on the scan review screen with no default; scanning never sets it.

application:business-rule:monthly-reset-.decision: Spent total = expenses dated in the current calendar month in the budget's time zone; expenses are kept; no rollover; computed at read time. These are the unified app's own rules, not Tallyho's (undocumented).

application:business-rule:personal-vs-bu.decision: Every expense has an author; budget is optional; a personal expense is visible to its author only.

application:business-rule:scanned-date-t.decision: Scanned date shown as 'check this date' and must be confirmed before saving; missing, future or more-than-90-days-old dates are replaced by today and flagged.

application:data-protection:receipt-imag.decision: Receipt images in private storage, served only through the expense's permission check, deleted with the expense; OCR provider behind an adapter, chosen by the user at implementation (their account and keys; prefer a no-retention option). Not decided in plan mode.

database:duplicate-entity:expense.decision: One Expense entity: id, author_id, budget_id (nullable), amount_minor, currency, spent_on, merchant, category, note, receipt_id, created_at, updated_at; every field's origin in architecture.json.

database:unknown-type:expense.amount.decision: Tallyho's type cannot be found (closed, undocumented); not needed because no Tallyho data is imported. Unified type: bigint minor units (Spendly's integer cents).

database:unknown-type:expense.category.decision: Tallyho's type and values are unknown; its category field is dropped (M10). Unified: text constrained to food, travel, home, other.

database:unknown-type:expense.primary-ke.decision: Neither source has a known key (Spendly none, Tallyho undocumented). Unified: uuid generated by the app.

migration:expense.decision: Plan approved: NO migration runs. These steps describe a hypothetical import of Tallyho data whose types are undocumented; this plan imports no Tallyho data and Spendly persists nothing, so the unified schema starts empty. Any later Tallyho import (through its API with the user's token) needs network and token approvals, its own migration plan, and a separate migration approval.
